title: Headed to the Festival of Genomics Boston 2026?
summary: Visit Booth 1A to meet with the Knowledge Center team!
bodyHtml:
The Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE) Knowledge Center will be exhibiting at the Festival of Genomics Biodata & AI conference June 3-4, 2026 at booth 1A.

June 3rd, 20268:30 AM–5:30 PM
June 4th, 20268:45 AM–3:30 PM

We invite you to join our ancillary session "From Prompt to Provenance: AI enhanced contextual workflow across the Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE)" on June 3, 2026 from 4:10 PM - 5:40 PM in Room 50. Participants can learn how AI can guide researchers from a natural-language question to structured, KG-driven discovery bridging datasets, ontologies, APIs, and literature without replacing expert judgment.
